headword: {給与明細|きゅうよめいさい}

definitions.gloss: pay stub; salary statement; pay slip
definitions.explanation: A document from an employer showing the breakdown of an employee's pay, including base salary, deductions for taxes and insurance, overtime pay, and net amount.

examples.japanese: {給与明細|きゅうよめいさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{給与明細|きゅうよめいさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: This month's pay statement arrived electronically.

examples.japanese: {給与明細|きゅうよめいさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}たら→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれていた→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: When I looked at my pay stub, more tax had been deducted than I expected.

notes:
USAGE:
An essential document for working adults in Japan. Companies provide these monthly, either on paper or electronically. Important for filing tax returns and applying for loans.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {給与明細|きゅうよめいさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ (to check one's pay stub)
- {給与明細|きゅうよめいさい}{書|しょ} (pay statement document)
- ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧{給与明細|きゅうよめいさい} (electronic pay stub)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{給与|きゅうよ}→給与：00264_kyuuyo⟧: salary — the pay itself, not the document
- {源泉徴収票|げんせんちょうしゅうひょう}: withholding tax statement — the annual tax summary, different from the monthly pay stub
